headline: DoorDash says a database connectivity issue on an internal address service caused the Nov 21 errors; it has not mentioned an attack.
summary: DoorDash posted a post-incident note on its status page at 3:12 PM ET on Nov 24 for the 'Health Degredation' incident (added as s010, Tier 1, read directly). It says some partners saw elevated errors and delays across DoorDash services, including order creation and confirmation, from about 7:55 to 8:45 AM PT (10:55 to 11:45 AM ET), caused by a database connectivity issue on an internal address service. c009 Not established to Confirmed, with its claim text narrowed to what DoorDash stated; q002 answered. The note does not mention an attack, so c007 stays Unverified, c008 stays Not established and the main answer stays Not established (answer text refreshed). The Drive incident's post mortem is still pending, so c006 stays Not established. Status monitors (PulsAPI, Pingoru, Uptimus) relay the same note; no news coverage found. Before changing the main answer text we reviewed the Microsoft 365, Apple and FAA pages: Apple's moved only after an explicit denial, so ours does not. Staleness check done: known and not-known lists, who_is_affected, figures, q001, q003 and the checked-not-found note refreshed. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.

headline: DoorDash marked both status incidents resolved and says a post mortem will be posted later; the cause is still not given.
summary: We read DoorDash's official status page feed directly at www.doordashstatus.com (added as s009, Tier 1). The Drive incident was marked resolved at 1:58 PM ET. The 'Health Degredation' incident was marked resolved at 2:50 PM ET with a note that it ended at 11:51 AM ET; it names only the Merchant - Marketplace Orders component, with impact none. c002 Reported to Confirmed (direct read of the official page, as the Editor-in-Chief asked) and c010 Not established to Confirmed. The Drive API component says 'Post Mortem will be posted later'; c009 stays Not established until one is published. No cyberattack statement, customer figure or link to other outages; c006, c007, c008 and c011 unchanged. Staleness check done: known and not-known lists, who_is_affected, q002, q003 and the checked-not-found note refreshed. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.

headline: Status monitors relay the title and text of DoorDash's second status incident; both incidents are still open and no cause is given.
summary: Two status monitors that read DoorDash's official feed (PulsAPI and FlareWarden, added as s007 and s008) give the second incident's title, 'DoorDash Health Degredation' (DoorDash's spelling), and its text. c002 stays Reported: the monitors relay DoorDash's own feed and we could not open the status page ourselves. c010 stays Not established: at 1:52 PM ET all 16 components showed operational, but neither incident had a Resolved update. No cause, post-incident report, cyberattack statement, customer figure or link to other outages found; c007 stays Unverified. Staleness check done: c010 summary, q003 answer, known list and the checked-not-found note refreshed. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.

headline: DoorDash's Nov 21 outage has no stated cause; a hack is only social-media speculation.
summary: First draft. 6 sources (1 Tier 1 not readable by us, 3 Tier 2, 2 Tier 3), 11 claims (1 Confirmed, 4 Reported, 1 Unverified, 5 Not established), 5 questions. The status page, Men's Journal and IsDown agree on the 11:30 Drive incident and 11:50 recovery. status.doordash.com could not be opened by our fetch and Men's Journal returned an access block, so their content was read through the IsDown mirror and search-result text; both are marked blocked. The hack claim is Unverified: only a social-media question quoted by Hindustan Times. No cause, post-incident report, resolution time or user count found. Outlets disagree on the Downdetector figure and start time; both are noted. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
